gloss: the sun sets; it gets dark

definitions.gloss: the sun sets; it gets dark; evening falls
definitions.explanation: Describes the sun going down and daylight fading. A natural, everyday expression for sunset and the onset of evening.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れるのが{早|はや}くなった。
examples.english: The sun has started setting earlier.

examples.japanese: {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れる{前|まえ}に{家|いえ}に{帰|かえ}りなさい。
examples.english: Come home before it gets dark.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}になると{日|ひ}が{暮|く}れるのが{早|はや}いので、{四時|よじ}にはもう{暗|くら}くなっている。
examples.english: In winter the sun sets early, so it's already dark by four o'clock.

notes:
USAGE:
A very common everyday expression. The subject {日|ひ} refers to the sun/daylight. {暮|く}れる means to come to an end or to darken. Often used to talk about seasonal changes in daylight hours.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れる{前|まえ}に (before sunset)
- {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れるのが{早|はや}い (the sun sets early)
- {日|ひ}が{暮|く}れてから (after dark)

RELATED WORDS:
- {日|ひ}が{沈|しず}む: the sun sinks/sets — focuses on the physical sun
- {夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ: dusk, twilight — the time period itself
